newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: PanCanadian grp wins Venezuelan B2X.70/80 oil deal.
newsitem.headline: PanCanadian grp wins Venezuelan B2X.70/80 oil deal.

text.p: Sole bidders PanCanadian Petroleum Ltd and Penzoil Exploration and Production Co bid $1.3 million Thursday for the contract to operate Venezuela's B2X.70/80 oil field, state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) said.
No other companies or consortia bid for the field, on the fourth day of Venezuela's third auction round of operating licenses.
Over the first three days, total bids reached $1.5 billion.

The 42 km square field, discovered in Lake Maracaibo in 1950, currently produces 5,500 barrels per day (bpd) of 20-25 API crude from 72 active wells. Proven reserves are 168 million barrels, according to PDVSA estimates. Another 14 wells are inactive.

Under the 20-year contract, the operator will produce hydrocarbons on behalf of PDVSA subsidiary Lagoven in exchange for a fee worked out on a sliding scale. The operator must also invest at least $17 million within three years, although PDVSA expects investment to be higher.
A total of 131 companies are competing for 20 contracts to be sold this week with the winners determined purely by the size of their bids.
